critic raised a concrete objection: You blended incompatible units. The FY2026Q3 adjusted EPS guidance is $3.30 (USD/share), but you averaged it with a “seasonal_trend” of -0.119167 that appears to be a percentage (-11.9167%), treating it as an absolute dollar amount. Your math subtracts only $0.013 (=-0.119167×0.111) from the weighted guidance, which is dimensionally wrong. If -0.119167 is a percent, it must first be applied to an EPS level (e.g., -11.9167% of $3.30 ≈ -$0.39) before combining. As used, the 2.92009 result is on the wrong basis.
